# portal.voyage

portal.voyage is a data map that ranks world cities by cost of living, career opportunity, and Schelling points (where the people you admire cluster) to help you decide where to live. You set your budget, your field, and the people you want to be near, and it scores cities on the three things that actually decide the move: your runway, your career upside, and your people. It treats Earth as an open world where every city is a DLC your passport unlocks. It is built for digital nomads, relocators, and remote workers making the biggest decision nobody helps you make with data.
